miRNA profiling revealed differential expression of four miRNAs, including hsa-mi-31, in chordomas compared to healthy nucleus pulposis.
miRNA profiling showed the downregulation of miR-31 in chordoma compared to healthy nucleus pulposis, and that miR-31 has apoptotic effect on the chordoma cell line.
we found 53 miRNas that are differentially expressed between chordoma and nucleus pulposus, and that hsa-mir-31, hsal-mir-222, hsal-miR-141-3p and has-miR-147a are down regulated in chordomas.
